subject: Coastal Spine & Pain — Q4 planning
transcript:
[00:00] Sam Okafor: Thanks for making time. Where do you want to start?
[00:12] Dr. Elena Ruiz: The site still looks like the old practice — can we get it rebuilt before the open house in October?
[04:38] Dr. Elena Ruiz: And on the ads — I want to know how many of those actually turned into booked appointments, not just form fills.
summary: Q4 planning call. Website rebuild before the October open house, and booking attribution for the paid campaign.
